status: authored 2026-10-23 (offline: table, generator, audit; NOTHING installed in any world, not seen in game)
owner_brief: the owner, 2026-10-22: "yeah go ahead and add pokemon to caves"
why: No wild Pokemon spawned underground over most of the map. Every compiled surface detail forces canSeeSky true (tools/compile_spawns.py box_condition), and tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py removes inherited (Cobblemon, Cobbleverse) details under every route and sub-region box at EVERY height (box_anticondition is x/z only), so the inherited cave spawns went too. This table is our own pool for the six dug systems, one pack, cobblers_underground_spawns, which the suppression tool never reads (its collect() skips every cobblers_* pack).
condition_fields: Every detail's condition is {minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ, canSeeSky false, dimensions [minecraft:overworld]}. Source of the fields: Cobblemon 1.8.0 SpawningCondition lists canSeeSky and minX/minY/minZ/maxX/maxY/maxZ (docs/research/notes/underground-biomes.md section 3c, VERIFIED in source); stock zubat-4 in the 1.8.2 jar uses canSeeSky false, noibat-2 uses maxY 0, and the dimension binding is tools/compile_spawns.py bind_dimension. The position type is 'grounded' as every stock cave detail in the jar (zubat, geodude, noibat) and every compiled detail here; no 'air' position is used because no file in the repository or the jar gives a bat one.
bands: Three depth bands per system, shallow / mid / deep, each a minY..maxY slice of the whole system box. Caves: data/cave_systems.json rules.levels put the four floors at y 66 (upper), 30 (middle), -8 (deep) and -30 (abyss); shallow is y 48 up to the system's highest centreline node + 8 (the mouths climb to the surface), mid is 12..47, deep is -64..11. Mines: bands group the levels of derived/mine_networks/plan.json (floors listed per system); a band runs from 2 under its lowest floor to 12 over the highest (a 4-high drift, a 6-high stope) and the bands are contiguous, deep reaching -64.
box_basis: Cave boxes are the plan's bounds (derived/cave_systems/plan.json systems.<id>.bounds, x/z) padded 64; mine boxes are the x/z extent of the plan's runs, stopes, inclines and shafts padded 64 and kept inside the network's own box (data/mine_networks.json networks.<id>.box). tests/test_underground_spawns.py re-reads the plan, when derived/ has one, and fails if any of it lies outside the box.
keep_out: The compiler cuts out of every box (a) data/spawn_suppression.json spawn_free_zones and (b) every data/towns.json footprint (padded 16) that meets it, at every height: a town's roofs and rooms are not caves. A sweep over both files, not a list of ours. NOT covered: placed structures that are not a town (the Route 1 mansion beside the Old Seams' mansion mouth, the Great Oak's tree), which the world holds and no footprint here lists.
levels: A system's levels follow its band of play: the mines' crews (data/mine_crews.json networks.<id>.band, level by level) and, for the caves, the tier of the nearest town (data/encounter_design.json rules.tiers: band and cap). Levels rise with depth inside the band; the rare and ultra-rare picks sit at the band's top. An evolved stage is never spawned below the level its pre-evolution needs (the jar's evolutions), and no level exceeds the system's cap.
weights: common 12 (9 for the second-line species), uncommon 6, rare 2, ultra-rare 1: data/spawns.json rarity family_weight per bucket.
